C1001.title: CF Ranked Match Throwers and Boosting Penalty Announcement
C1001.summary: On March 11, 2022, CrossFire issued an official notice investigating and punishing malicious acting and paid rank boosting in ranked matches, conduct that seriously affected player experience and fairness. After verification by the security team, violating players faced penalties starting with rank point clearing, tiered ranked-match bans of up to 180 days, additional account bans, and publication of penalty lists.

references.title: Breaking News: Crackdown on Actor Point Feeding and Boosting in CrossFire Ranked Matches - Official Announcement
